newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish resistance to EMU virtually unchanged - poll.
newsitem.headline: Danish resistance to EMU virtually unchanged - poll.

text.p: Danish resistance to the EU's economic and monetary union (EMU) has changed little over the past three months, an opinion poll published on Monday in the financial daily Borsen said.

The survey, by Greens polling institute, showed 55.9 percent of respondents saying that Denmark should stick to its existing policy of staying out of monetary union, compared to 55.6 percent in a March poll.

The latest survey, of 1,015 respondents over the period from June 2 to June 4, showed 32.5 percent in favour of EMU compared to 33.4 percent in March, while the number of don't knows grew to 11.6 percent in the new poll from 10.9 percent.
